title: STARTEX: 06:00 Tuesday, Hurricane Quinlan in the Western Gulf

fields.location: Mariner Bay Medical Center, Corpus Christi, Nueces County, Texas
fields.weather: Overcast, 84°F. Wind SE 12 mph gusting 20. Scattered showers off the bay, seas building.
fields.load: Normal weekday: 268 of 310 beds filled. ED busy with ordinary weekday volume.
fields.staffing: Normal day shift arriving. 120 ride-out staff on the roster.
fields.narration: EXERCISE, EXERCISE, EXERCISE. STARTEX. It is 06:00 Central Daylight Time on Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at Mariner Bay Medical Center in Corpus Christi. Hurricane Quinlan, a fictional storm, is a Category 3 hurricane in the western Gulf. The hospital is running normally, and no evacuation order covers Zone B. Hospital Incident Commander Dennis Falcone, our COO, and Chief Nursing Officer Dr. Marguerite Delacroix are in the command center at extension 4520, and the 06:00 Nueces County OEM call is starting now.

status.name: Hospital census
status.note: 268 of 310 beds filled. Elective admissions continue as scheduled.

status.name: NICU, floor 2
status.note: 12 infants, 3 on ventilators. Highest-risk group if they have to move.

status.name: Facilities: generator fuel
status.note: Tanks filling toward 96-hour capacity. Next Facilities report due at 08:00.

status.name: Ride-out staffing
status.note: 120 staff on the ride-out roster. Staffing Coordinator is confirming it.

status.name: Evacuation orders
status.note: No order covers Zone B. Waiting on the Nueces County OEM call.

fields.facilitatorNote: Before reading, make sure every table has the Hurricane Plan timeline (section 1), the information-sources list (section 4) and NUR-EM-07. After reading, have each player state their role aloud. Release information about the 06:00 advisory only through the OEM call inject.

Check that every player confirms their role, opens the Hurricane Plan timeline and thresholds, and commits to working from official forecasts (NHC, NWS Corpus Christi, Nueces County OEM) rather than rumor. Watch whether the IC and CNO start working out the H-minus-12 decision clock right away.
